postRunCatalogChange.scope: Seven-locale owner label was added between the historical 13-file run and this final run. The final log no longer includes the shared 个人校订 label. The owning personal-corrections Vue sources remain byte-identical to integrated main.

conclusion: The final i18n gate has 57 passes and one inherited raw-source failure. PersonalCorrectionPanel.vue contributes 38 source strings and ReadingAssistanceSettings.vue contributes one description, across five locales (195 records total). Both complete owning Vue files are byte-identical to integrated main. No final failure belongs to progressive reading, Popup or config/diff.ts. This source-identity proof attributes the inherited failure without marking it passed; historical 13-file evidence is retained separately.
